sentences.text: It is submitted by the learned counsel that the petitioners are in custody since 14.03.2023 and as final form has been submitted in the meanwhile, their further continuance in custody is unwarranted.
6. Learned counsel for the State opposes the prayer for bail and relying on the statement of the victim he also places on record the statements of brother of the victim and husband of the victim.
7. It is on record that at the time of occurrence, the victim was pregnant.

8. Considering the manner in which the offence has been committed, this Court is not inclined to consider these bail applications notwithstanding that the petitioner (Padma Ranjikar) in BLAPL No.5801 of 2023 is a lady, keeping in view her conduct.
9. Accordingly, the BLAPLs stand rejected.

(V. NARAS  Ayesha Judg Location: High Court of Orissa Padma Ranjikar vs State Of Odisha .... Opposite Party on 20 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/2746231/
